citations.claim: Initial total mechanical energy before any motion.
Body moving toward +x wall at full speed just before the arena side-wall bounce.
Velocity reverses after elastic arena wall bounce with no loss, y falling under gravity.
First violating step: total energy exceeds initial plus 10 percent plus 5J with no controller work.

explanation: Single elastic (e=1) body with no walls and no controller bounces off the arena boundary. Gravity is conservative so total mechanical energy should be conserved, and wall bounce with e=1 should preserve speed. Instead total energy grows monotonically (1858.86 -> 1961.47 -> 1988.74 -> 2019.21 -> 2052.88), exceeding allowed 2049.75 at step 11. Likely cause is numerical energy injection by semi-implicit Euler at large dt=1/30 combined with substepped free-fall and an energy-preserving wall impulse that keeps the inflated velocity, accumulating error past tolerance.
vision_note: A single blue circle drifts slightly across an empty arena from steps 8 to 11, remaining well inside the bounds with no visible explosion, tunneling, or escape. No walls, waypoints, or controller markers are visible and the motion looks normal to the eye.
